lines.text: Nine a.m. Your day starts with a briefing, not a scavenger hunt.
Ask Agent pulls last night's conversations, open work and today's calls into one page.
Ten. Customers are writing in. Echo answers what your docs already cover, and hands you the rest, with context.
Eleven. Your planning call. Decisions and action items land in your projects, each with an owner.
One p.m. This morning's bug is now a pull request. Forge wrote it. Lens checked it. You approve it.
Three. It ships. Quill drafts the docs update, and the customers who asked get an answer.
Five. Before your renewal call, the whole account story is one question away.
Six. You spent the day on the work, not the handoffs.
